1315-3293-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1315-3293-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1315-3293-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

586-678-5256.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2730-4247-6553.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-7492.description:
Cast Fanatical Firebrand by paying its mana cost.
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
2438-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-969-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-969-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2438-5003-7283-7649.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-5003-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

2724-4006-7068.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Baboon Spirit. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2595-5147--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

206-1374-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
206-1374-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1402-2644-4763-7297.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-5233-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5233-7201.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5921-5970-6965.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4924-5638-7070.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
4924-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
4924-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

3967-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

585-1238-2351-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken until end of turn.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat from step 2.

1021-2034-6620-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-2034-6620-6761.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-2034-6620-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

428-1694-2770-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
428-1694-2770-5361.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1909-4486-5614.notablePrerequisites: Bighorner Rancher does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature whose power has been boosted by 1 or more.
1909-4486-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat.
1909-4486-5614.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1283-2816-4241.notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2816-4241.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability if you control a colored permanent.

77-2618-4399-4845.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Spirit Loop.
Spirit Loop triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Spirit Loop by paying two life, targeting Hero of Iroas.
Defiler of Faith and Hero of Iroas triggers.
Resolve the Hero or Iroas trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1633-1908-3415-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant or sorcery this turn.
1633-1908-3415-5195.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least two token copies of Storm-Kiln Artist with haste.
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Hanabi Blast and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4019-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Bloom Tender has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a white, black and/or red permanent.
4019-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}{G}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

168-2210-4948-5290.description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {2}{U}.
Mirrormade enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Mirrormade's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Estrid's Invocation by paying {2}{U}.
Estrid's Invocation enters the battlefield as a copy of the Oblivion Ring copy, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation's trigger, exiling Mirrormade.
Mirrormade leaves the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Sage of Mysteries and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Estrid's Invocation.
Estrid's Invocation leaves the battlefield, returning Mirrormade from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until each opponent has an empty library, then end the loop by choosing to copy or exile any other permanent.

3249-5004-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {R}.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Cathodion.
Cast Cathodion from graveyard by paying {3}.
Repeat.

4222-4418.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Mul Daya Channelers.
Land on top of your library.
Mul Daya Channelers does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4418.description:
Activate Mul Daya Channelers by tapping, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untap Mul Daya Channelers.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may activate Mul Daya Channelers for infinite mana of any colors.
